scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hangang-compass/domain && npm run build --workspace @hangang-compass/api && npm run build --workspace @hangang-compass/web
scripts.check: npm run security:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @hangang-compass/domain && npm run dev --workspace @hangang-compass/api
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @hangang-compass/domain && tsx --test domain/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
